FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-vertical-force-balance/diiid-external-current-propagation.html:23 non-blocking: The seam row's max|dpsi| 2.009e-05 is differenced against prototype/cold/arm-base.npz, not the prototype2/cold base the row and warm-base rows use (that pair gives 2.902e-05), and no landed script computes the column, so the table silently mixes three jobs and four base arm files and a reader cannot reconstruct which base each row was measured against; both seam values remain four orders below the 1.2045 Wb positive control, so the conclusion is unaffected.
